digest.component_or_area: pytest test harness / snapshot fixture cleanup
propositions: Snapshot test teardown fails on macOS because read-only .rebar/run_snapshots directories (0444/0555 perms set by _chmod_readonly) cannot be removed by ordinary shutil.rmtree when tests execute in any module other than tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py

The module-local snapshot teardown fixture _remove_readonly_snapshot_after_test in tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py does not run for snapshot-producing tests in other modules, leaving non-removable cache roots below pytest basetemp

Cleanup responsibility was centralized by moving the exact .rebar/run_snapshots removal logic into tests/conftest.py as an autouse fixture that searches only below each test-owned tmp_path and reuses snapshot._rmtree_writable to restore write permissions
After shared teardown completes, all .rebar/run_snapshots roots below pytest tmp_path are removable by ordinary shutil.rmtree, while adjacent unrelated temporary content remains untouched
